description: This file implements the core logic for managing Miracast connections, including device discovery, connection management, session control, and event handling, within a MiracastController class. It interacts with lower-level P2P and network components to facilitate wireless display sessions.

classes.name: MiracastController
classes.description: This class manages Miracast sessions, device discovery, connections, and event handling.

classes.name: DeviceInfo
classes.description: Structure holding information about a device (not shown but implied).

classes.name: GroupInfo
classes.description: Structure holding information about a P2P group.

classes.name: MiracastThread
classes.description: Thread abstraction used for asynchronous operations.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Singleton method to obtain the MiracastController instance.

methods.name: destroyInstance
methods.description: Destroys the singleton instance of MiracastController.

methods.name: create_ControllerFramework
methods.description: Initializes the connection framework, starts the control thread, and sets up P2P.

methods.name: destroy_ControllerFramework
methods.description: Cleans up the session, stops threads, and releases resources.

methods.name: discover_devices
methods.description: Starts discovering nearby Miracast devices.

methods.name: stop_discover_devices
methods.description: Stops the ongoing device discovery process.

methods.name: connect_device
methods.description: Initiates connection to a device given its MAC address and name.

methods.name: set_FriendlyName
methods.description: Sets the local friendly name for the device.

methods.name: get_FriendlyName
methods.description: Retrieves the current friendly name of the device.

methods.name: get_localIp
methods.description: Returns the local IP address being used in the session.

methods.name: get_connected_device_mac
methods.description: Returns the MAC address of the connected device.

methods.name: get_allPeers
methods.description: Returns a list of all peer devices discovered.

methods.name: get_connection_status
methods.description: Returns the current connection status.

methods.name: set_enable
methods.description: Enables or disables the Miracast service.

methods.name: restart_session
methods.description: Restarts the current Miracast session.

methods.name: stop_session
methods.description: Stops the current Miracast session.

methods.name: remove_P2PGroupInstance
methods.description: Removes the current P2P group.

methods.name: event_handler
methods.description: Main event handler for processing P2P and other messages.

methods.name: ControllerThreadCallback
methods.description: Thread callback that runs the Controller_Thread method after a delay.

methods.name: create_TestNotifier
methods.description: Creates and starts a test notifier thread for testing Miracast notifications.

methods.name: destroy_TestNotifier
methods.description: Stops and cleans up the test notifier thread.

methods.name: TestNotifier_Thread
methods.description: Main loop for processing incoming test notifier messages, invoking handler callbacks.

methods.name: send_msgto_test_notifier_thread
methods.description: Sends a message to the test notifier thread's message queue.
